verdict.rationale: Appwrite documents its own deletion capabilities: Storage APIs to delete files, and CLI/API management of rows, files and users. Buckets can also strip location, device and capture-time metadata from uploaded images, a form of data minimization. There is no evidence of configurable retention policies, TTL or auto-expiry, or account or data purge guarantees. Self-hosting control over data location is adjacent residency, not retention, and earns no credit. Missing for 10: configurable retention/TTL policies, documented user or account data deletion guarantees (including backup/PITR purge), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
